page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved plate with a title tablet. Top right corner: page number. Centre: a large figure of a man in armour standing on a pedestal, with a kneeling figure and a plinth inscription. Below the figure: a central tablet with the inscription. Left panel labelled PIETAS, right panel with a Greek caption below it. No running text.
page.notes: The plinth inscription under the figure is too worn to read beyond its first words; the Greek caption at lower right is partly unclear, and the page number may read 218 with some doubt. The pedestal's small inscription is set in capitals and is copied as far as legible. The engraving itself (armoured standing figure, kneeling figure, tools, skull, mace, left and right allegorical panels) is not transcribed as text.
